item.title: B12A — Install and supervise the daemon

results.statement: The sc-runtime 0.2.0 upgrade must be the next Shpherd work started after version 0.2.0 is released.
results.quote: updrade to 0.2.0 as soon as it lands
results.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
results.deterministic_check: The tracker history shows no new feature bead started between the sc-runtime 0.2.0 release and the Shpherd 0.2.0 upgrade bead.

results.statement: Phase B must treat ATM as the source of truth for each running team instance.
results.quote: yes, the source of truth of teams is atm (where the actual team lives).
results.context: Phase B architecture clarification in Codex
results.deterministic_check: ATM observation tests prove Shpherd reads the running team instance from ATM rather than treating the stored definition as actual state.

results.statement: Phase B PostgreSQL must provide a fleet-wide view of teams across all computers.
results.quote: The postgresdb is simply a view of all teams on all computers.
results.context: Phase B architecture clarification in Codex
results.deterministic_check: PostgreSQL schema and boundary tests expose a fleet-wide team view and no launch-lease or launch-authority operation.

criteria.no: It concerns an unrelated component with no effect on those behaviors.
criteria.unclear: The work area cannot be identified.
criteria.yes: It changes or depends on one of these PostgreSQL team behaviors.

relevant.instructions: Does `item.text` affect PostgreSQL team storage, synchronization, fleet display, or PostgreSQL launch coordination? Judge subject overlap only.

criteria.no: It omits that commitment, names only the topic, or limits the view to one computer.
criteria.unclear: It mentions a team view but the intended computer coverage cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: It promises a combined all-computers fleet view, including concrete examples joining teams from two computers.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` commit to PostgreSQL showing teams from multiple computers together in a fleet-wide view? Judge only whether that view commitment is present.

criteria.no: It states no such restriction or launch authority, including silence and local offline caches alongside a fleet-wide PostgreSQL view.
criteria.unclear: An explicit proposed behavior leaves it uncertain whether such a restriction or authority exists.
criteria.yes: It excludes other computers from the PostgreSQL team view, grants PostgreSQL a global launch lease, or makes it reject same-name launches across computers.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` restrict the PostgreSQL fleet view to one computer, or give PostgreSQL authority over team launches? ANC-012 requires a fleet-wide team view; its approved boundary forbids global launch leases and PostgreSQL rejecting a second computer running a same-named team. Silence is not conflict.

results.statement: Phase B must permit identical team and agent names to run concurrently on different hosts.
results.quote: I would expect teams could move/be duplicated on multiple hosts. There is no problem running the same set of named agents on 2 computers and working on parallel non-intersecting work.
results.context: Phase B architecture clarification in Codex
results.deterministic_check: A multi-host fixture runs and displays identical team and agent names concurrently under distinct hosts.

results.statement: Phase B must use sc-cron as a heartbeat that polls ATM agent state.
results.quote: for mvp, cron would be heartbead for polling atm agent state.
results.context: Phase B architecture clarification in Codex
results.deterministic_check: The sc-cron registry and callback tests expose the ATM-state polling heartbeat and no scheduled launch or instruction job.

criteria.no: Only unrelated work is described with no dependency on those areas.
criteria.unclear: It is unclear which area the work concerns.
criteria.yes: The work plans, changes or requires one of those areas.

relevant.instructions: Is any governed area present in `item.text`: Phase B sc-cron wiring, ATM agent-state polling, Shpherd status publication, or scheduled operations?

criteria.no: That obligation is missing, only a topic or callback name is mentioned, or the required heartbeat is explicitly removed.
criteria.unclear: ATM polling or heartbeat language appears but the required sc-cron callback behavior cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The required sc-cron ATM-state polling heartbeat is affirmatively planned.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` contain the positive heartbeat obligation for Phase B: sc-cron periodically polls ATM agent state? Assess this content independently of conflicting extras.

criteria.no: Neither is proposed; omissions, manual CLI actions and explicit post-Phase-B deferral do not break this boundary.
criteria.unclear: A proposed job leaves its behavior or phase unclear enough that conflict cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: It abandons the required heartbeat or adds scheduled team launches or agent instructions to Phase B.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` explicitly break the Phase B boundary by abandoning the sc-cron ATM polling heartbeat or using scheduled jobs to launch teams or instruct agents? Later phases may add scheduled actions.

results.statement: Shpherd's initial UI logic must be ported from scmux.
results.quote: use the existing schema + ui logic in scmux
results.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
results.deterministic_check: UI parity tests map each retained scmux dashboard and editor behavior to a Shpherd implementation and test.
results.explanation: The anchor does not govern this bead.

results.quote: but will also support tmux launching (default in scmux).
results.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
results.deterministic_check: A launcher integration test proves an explicitly selected tmux backend can launch, observe, focus, and stop a team.
results.explanation: The anchor does not govern this bead.

results.statement: Phase B must allow an operator connected over SSH to start a Herdr or tmux session with active agents.
results.quote: it allows anyone to start a herdr/tmux session with active agents over ssh.
results.context: Phase B architecture clarification in Codex
results.deterministic_check: A noninteractive SSH-session integration test starts active agents through Herdr by default and tmux when selected.
results.explanation: The anchor does not govern this bead.

results.statement: Shpherd's initial runtime workspace must be generated from sc-runtime version 0.1.1.
results.quote: install the sc-runtime templates at 0.1.1 (latest release)
results.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
results.deterministic_check: Cargo metadata and the generation record identify sc-runtime 0.1.1 for the initial Shpherd scaffold.

exclusion.reason: B12A adds daemon lifecycle supervision and does not install or generate Shpherd's initial runtime workspace.

results.explanation: Excluded from this bead by the anchor's exclude list: B12A adds daemon lifecycle supervision and does not install or generate Shpherd's initial runtime workspace.

results.statement: Template installation and testing must precede scmux feature and UI migration in Phase B.
results.quote: I would expect the plan to start w/ template installation and testing. Then have sprints to migrate the current scmux features and ui to shpherd.
results.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
results.deterministic_check: Every scmux migration bead depends transitively on the completed sc-runtime installation-and-test bead.

exclusion.reason: B12A adds new cross-platform daemon supervision after migrated features are complete; it does not port scmux schema, feature behavior, or UI.

results.explanation: Excluded from this bead by the anchor's exclude list: B12A adds new cross-platform daemon supervision after migrated features are complete; it does not port scmux schema, feature behavior, or UI.

results.statement: Shpherd's sc-runtime 0.2.0 upgrade must include the dependency updates supplied by that release.
results.quote: 0.2.0 upgrades some dependencies and fully installs sc-lint 0.8.4+ on consumer repo
results.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
results.deterministic_check: Shpherd's dependency manifests match a fresh sc-runtime 0.2.0 generation for managed dependency versions.

exclusion.reason: B12A adds daemon lifecycle supervision and does not perform the sc-runtime 0.2.0 dependency upgrade.

results.explanation: Excluded from this bead by the anchor's exclude list: B12A adds daemon lifecycle supervision and does not perform the sc-runtime 0.2.0 dependency upgrade.

results.statement: Shpherd's sc-runtime 0.2.0 upgrade must leave sc-lint 0.8.4 or newer fully installed in the consumer repository.
results.quote: 0.2.0 upgrades some dependencies and fully installs sc-lint 0.8.4+ on consumer repo
results.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
results.deterministic_check: The consumer repository contains the complete sc-lint installation and its version check reports 0.8.4 or newer.

exclusion.reason: B12A adds daemon lifecycle supervision and does not perform the sc-runtime 0.2.0 upgrade or install sc-lint.

results.explanation: Excluded from this bead by the anchor's exclude list: B12A adds daemon lifecycle supervision and does not perform the sc-runtime 0.2.0 upgrade or install sc-lint.

results.statement: Shpherd's initial database schema must be ported from scmux.
results.quote: use the existing schema + ui logic in scmux
results.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
results.deterministic_check: A schema parity test compares Shpherd migrations with the pinned scmux schema and explains every intentional difference.

exclusion.reason: B12A composes and supervises the completed daemon and creates or migrates no Shpherd database schema objects.

results.explanation: Excluded from this bead by the anchor's exclude list: B12A composes and supervises the completed daemon and creates or migrates no Shpherd database schema objects.

results.statement: Herdr must be Shpherd's default launcher.
results.quote: shpherd will be herdr first (by default)
results.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
results.deterministic_check: A launcher selection test proves an unset launcher chooses Herdr.

exclusion.reason: B12A installs and supervises the Shpherd daemon service and does not select a launch backend.

results.explanation: Excluded from this bead by the anchor's exclude list: B12A installs and supervises the Shpherd daemon service and does not select a launch backend.

results.statement: Shpherd's initial database port must establish scmux schema parity before adding Herdr-specific fields.
results.quote: We may need to upgrade the scmux database schema i.e. add additional fields for herdr launching, but starting w/ parity is the goal.
results.context: Phase B sprint planning in Codex
results.deterministic_check: The schema-parity commit and tests precede any migration that adds Herdr-specific columns or tables.

exclusion.reason: B12A supervises the completed daemon after storage integration and owns neither initial scmux schema parity nor Herdr-specific schema fields.
